reviews.quote: I was a first-time client and just happened to be close by and walked in with no appointment. They had no problem squeezing me in for a 30-minute foot massage, took their time, and really cared about my problem areas, explaining what they were doing as we went along. I left feeling like I was walking on clouds. Definitely will be back soon!
reviews.author: Michael
